summary: Which typeface the text uses, as a list of fallbacks.
details: The browser uses the first font in the list that it has. Always end with a generic family (sans-serif, serif, monospace, system-ui) so there is a sensible fallback. Set it once on a high-level element; children inherit it.

values.note: A classic serif, with a generic fallback.
Use the parent’s font (buttons and inputs do not by default).

gotcha: Buttons, inputs and other form controls do not inherit font-family. Add font: inherit to them, or they keep the browser’s own small font.
